subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Employees are working from home and shoppers are ordering groceries online to minimize time in crowded spaces.

options.text: Employees are working from home and
to minimize time in crowded spaces.

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is** grammatically correct as it stands.**
 
• Both clauses **"Employees are working from home"** and** "shoppers are ordering groceries online"** are **correctly constructed and logically connected.**
 
• The phrase **"to minimize time in crowded spaces"** is also** correctly used** and provides a valid reason for the actions mentioned in the sentence.

Hence, the correct statement is** ''*Employees are working from home and shoppers are ordering groceries online to minimize time in crowded spaces*."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ensure that the sentences are logically connected and provide clear reasoning for actions mentioned.
 
• When checking for errors, look for subject-verb agreement, correct usage of phrases, and logical consistency.
